frp1372.mechanism: Keep each bounded 512-bit load and split its destination transfer into two 256-bit stores.

frp1374.mechanism: Read and write in 256-bit vectors across the same bounded 256-byte bulk groups.

constantBlockRowTrial.mechanism: Use an inline constant-size disjoint transfer for each checked 256-byte bulk block.

reverseIndependentRowsTrial.mechanism: Reverse the order of independent, noncancelable SIMD RGBA8 rows with the existing signed-stride helper.
reverseIndependentRowsTrial.preflightIdleRefusedBeforeSamples: An idle VBCSCompiler process from our build remained active. Shut down the build server and rerun the guard before the first worker starts.

stagedNextRowTrial.mechanism: Stage four next-row head vectors before finishing the current tail for distinct noncancelable RGBA8 rows.

stagedWholeRowTrial.mechanism: Combine the four staged head vectors with the twelve remaining checked row vectors before storing the current row.

alignedMiddleTrial.mechanism: Align middle stores using one released destination hint and at most one bounded store at each edge.

stripTraversalTrial.mechanism: Check four-row strips and reuse horizontal copy-block offsets across each strip.

twoCompleteRowSnapshotsTrial.design: Two complete independent rows loaded before either store, with original odd-final-row and ineligible routes

nativeArrayPlacementDiagnostic.limitations: Static line footprint from low address bits and exact original geometry. Allocation instrumentation changes launch conditions. No cache miss, cycle, or causality claim.

pinFreeAlignedStoresTrial.mechanism: Opportunistic managed-reference alignment hint and checked unaligned-safe transfers

sharedNativeAndManaged.limitations: Common GC backing and in-process batch adapter are diagnostic. The native clipping body and FFmpeg archive are unchanged. Observer and language-runtime call boundaries still differ.

completeAndPreparedManaged.scope: Package's exact public call and exact byte-row helper, same backing, complete row copies. Prepared geometry and ownership outside that diagnostic clock. Observer wrappers are parallel but not instruction identical.

separateWordCopyConfidenceReview.conclusion: All three original mean differences are adverse, so additional precision alone cannot turn those effect estimates into parity. A shift magnitude derived at fixed spread and reference clocks is a sensitivity diagnostic. Shared-storage effects are in-process and remain unscored.

wordPreparedRuntimeRows.scope: Separate RGBA16 fitting one 4096-pixel cancellation chunk

stagedHeadAndTailStoreOrder.nextHeadBuildCorrection: Use the signed managed reference step before loading the first vector.

currentSeparateWordRuntime.source: Complete public DrawingCopy16 on CPU0, one 999 Hz software capture. Samples are instruction locations.
